title: Yellow Coconut Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A rich and creamy Jamaican chicken curry with a deep umami flavor, featuring cocoa powder and cooked in a cataplana vessel over binchotan charcoal, this satvik friendly dish is perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat on the binchotan charcoal grill
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides
Add the curry powder, cocoa powder, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute
Add the coconut milk and yellow curry paste, and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or with naan bread
